data.name: Heirlooms
data.detailed_description:
Heirlooms is a first-person grid-based dungeon crawler with an horror tinge. The forbidden spawn of old-school dungeon crawler classics and the bloodcurdling stories of H. P. Lovecraft, Robert W. Chambers and many others.

Step into the shoes of Jack, a man lured by a forgotten legacy - one that will drag him into the shadows of a truth buried beneath layers of silence, stone and madness.

Solve puzzles, explore time-worn ruins, and confront horrors beyond human understanding.

Features:

  • Shape your character with his background, equipment and skills.

  • Old-school grid based real-time combat. Fight with swift and cunning.

  • Many secrets and puzzles to test your mind.

  • An eerie and intriguing story to uncover.

Fear what should be left forgotten.

data.short_description: A letter has just arrived for you, Jack. Reclaim your legacy in this lovecraftian old-school dungeon crawler. Uncover misteries, face once buried horrors and survive. Fear what should be left forgotten.
